description: This file defines the PunchOutMenuConfigurator class which implements menu configuration for the 'time' module in the OrangeHRM attendance system. It overrides the module and screen settings for a specific menu configuration.

classes.name: PunchOutMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the punch out functionality within the OrangeHRM attendance module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module to 'time' and screen to 'punchIn' within the menu configuration context.
